title: VenueFile
description: Gameplay venues for one district: seeds/<world>/venues/<district>.yaml (CC BY 4.0). Per SPEC-CAREERS-AND-LOCATIONS §10 and §17. Each row says what a place is in the game (tier, kind, careers, needs met, sponsor slots) and where its name and point come from (name_source). Rows with name_source osm carry no name and no point: those live in the ODbL layer odbl/<city>/venues-osm.geojson (venue-osm.schema.json), joined by venue id at read time. V (institution) and B (business) venues are always fictional (name_source polis), or a real business name the business itself licenses (name_source licensed, Increment 2). Until the parcels table exists (P2.10) this file is the venue list; P2.10 migrates rows by id. v0.1.0 (2026-10-10, VENUE-OSM-0).

district.description: District slug (seeds/<world>/districts/<slug>.yaml). Every row's district must equal it.

id.description: Unique across all venue files. For name_source osm, equals the venue_id of exactly one feature in odbl/.

tier.description: L landmark, P public place, V fictional institution, B fictional business (SPEC §10).

name_source.description: osm: name and point come from odbl/ (L/P only). polis: our own name and hand-placed point. generic: no name of its own; shown as the parent venue's name plus slot_label (slot-labelled pitches). licensed: a real business name supplied by the business under a placement contract (B only, Increment 2).

name.description: Display name for polis and licensed rows only.

slot_label.description: Our label for a slot inside a parent venue, e.g. "Pitch 3". Shown as "<parent name> · <slot_label>".

parent_venue_id.description: For generic slot rows: the venue the slot sits in. The slot takes the parent's point.

host_venue_id.description: For a B stall sited at a public place (e.g. a stall at an OSM market), or a hand-labelled L/P place inside one: the host venue, whose point it takes. V venues never use it: they sit on their own non-OSM point (SPEC §10).

careers.description: Career ids that use this venue (e.g. footballer).

activities.description: What a character can do here, e.g. training, sunday_league, cup_final, kickabout, fitness.

needs_met.description: Needs a character can meet here by buying from a vendor (NEEDS-LITE: food and sleep; plus travel at station areas).

sponsor_slots.description: Billboard or stall slots that can be sold (SPON-1). Selling a slot never renames the venue.
